description: A strip marker removes raw vertical tab and form feed characters
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The vertical tab U+000B and form feed U+000C have the White_Space property but are not space separators (category Zs). Stripping them is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
